UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Stores a user's non-PII SAT studio workspace state, onboarding goals, diagnostic weights,starred questions, and serialized session summaries.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

displayName.description: Student display name entered during onboarding.

targetScore.description: Intended total SAT score between 400 and 1600.

payloadJson.description: Bounded workspace state snapshot (sessions, attempts, imported reports, weights, starred questions).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was last updated.

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Per-user SAT Studio workspace document keyed by the user's Auth UID.
